name: Oiligarchy
author: Addicting Games
description: Oiligraphy is a free strategic tycoon game where you run you use government resources to drill for oil. Play this interesting time-management game that relies on politics to be able to progress. Trash the environment, displace endangered animals, and take advantage of indigenous people. Do so by bribing politicians to pass legislation that benefits your business. You can also bribe the government of different regions to get rid of protestors or let you pollute their environment. This is a tycoon game that’s all about the profits and not about the people and animals you may hurt along the way. Don't feel rich enough? Then Drill, Baby, Drill!
